prerequisites: Science of materials (492): Ferrous materials: properties and applications.
Strength of materials (495): Stresses and strains, linear elastic constitutive equations, tension and compression, torsion, bending, buckling.

learning_outcomes.text: Understand and apply the fundamentals of elasticity theory.
Understand the concepts of exhaustion by plasticization and fracture and correctly apply the most common plasticization criteria.
Knowledge and abilities to apply the fundamentals of Elasticity and Strength of Materials to the behavior of real solids.

syllabus_topics: Deformable surface solids: plates and shells of revolution.
Description of stresses in deformable solids. Stress tensor
Description of strains in deformable solids.
Constitutive laws: relationship between stresses and strains. Plasticity criteria
Equations and Theorems of Elasticity. Principle of Virtual Work.
Two-dimensional elastic problem. Plane strain state. Plane stress state. Formulation in Cartesian coordinates.
Extension of Strength of Materials. Application of the Technical Building Code and the Structural Code.
Review of strength of materials and problems for the different topics
assessment_rules: To pass the subject, a minimum of 40% must be obtained in the exam. If this critical evaluation criterion is not met, the total grade for the subject will be FAIL, with the resulting score from the sum of the grades obtained in all evaluation systems, truncated to a maximum of 4.5 points.
